$schema_note: AUDIT-10 progress ledger. The FIRST thing a session writes (status=in_progress + date + lock) and the LAST thing it completes (status=complete + deliverable checklist). pass-1.notes: RESUMED by a new session; the earlier pass-1 lock (taken in pass-0's session) recorded steps_done=[] and appended no findings, so nothing was redone. THREE environment facts worth carrying forward. (1) php -S is single-threaded by default: running audit10-crawl.js and a second Chromium against :8123 at the same time wedged the crawler mid-page for minutes. The server was restarted with PHP_CLI_SERVER_WORKERS=6 and the two coexisted cleanly afterwards — later passes sharing this box should do the same. (2) Liberation Sans is installed here and is metric-compatible with Arial, which makes it a usable control for the C49 font caveat; four leads were refuted with it and two survived it. (3) PLAN-FILE OBSERVATION (recorded here, not acted on, per guardrails): routes.json parameterized_views lists /dashboard?family=Heat%20Shrink%20Tubing, but no product carries that partType and the site emits no such href, so that row captures a 0-result view by construction. NOT edited.

conflicts_and_questions.note: BRANCH CONFLICT, resolved in favour of the audit contract. The harness handed this session a designated branch 'claude/audit-10-pass-1-visual-ccj5eh' while manifest.git.branch and guardrails.write_allowlist.git_operations_allowed both name 'claude/audit-10'. The pass-1 prompt itself instructed `git fetch origin claude/audit-10 && git checkout claude/audit-10`, and the ledger lock protocol only works if every pass writes to the same branch, so the work is committed on claude/audit-10 and the same commits are mirrored to claude/audit-10-pass-1-visual-ccj5eh so the harness requirement is also satisfied. No plan file was edited.

routes.json parameterized_views lists /dashboard?family=Heat%20Shrink%20Tubing, but no product in products-all.json carries partType 'Heat Shrink Tubing' and the rendered site emits exactly ten family= hrefs, none of them that one. That row therefore captures a 0-result view that no visitor can reach from the site. Recorded, not fixed — plan files are the contract (guardrails hard_prohibitions).

passes 2/3/4/5/6 are running CONCURRENTLY in ONE shared working tree on one machine (not separate containers as the lock protocol assumed). Ledger lock commits have been sweeping up other sessions' uncommitted ledger edits (e.g. the pass-5 lock commit 9feaf83 contains pass-2's lock line). Hazards: finding-id allocation races on next_finding_id, interleaved findings.jsonl appends, shared :8123 server and Chromium load. pass-2 mitigations: stage only own paths, re-read ledger+findings.jsonl immediately before id allocation, never git reset/checkout -- on shared files. pass-7 should dedupe findings with extra care.
